info.biography: 三国时期吴国中书令、少傅。鲁王孙霸与太子孙和各植党羽，孙弘即依附孙霸。孙权病笃，而太子年少，于是以孙弘领少傅。孙权临终，召他与诸葛恪、孙峻等嘱以后事，孙弘与诸葛恪同为顾命大臣。孙权死后，孙弘因素来与诸葛恪不和，怕为所治，故隐瞒孙权死讯，欲矫诏除掉诸葛恪，被孙峻告发。后诸葛恪请孙弘议事，于座中将其诛杀。

skillRows.o: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以将手牌调整至与一名角色装备区里的牌数相同，每因此弃置一张牌，便随机获得弃牌堆中另一张类型相同的牌。

每阶段限一次，当你摸牌时，你可以改为获得一名其他角色等量张牌，然后其选择一项：
 1.摸等量张牌；
 2.你不能再对其发动武将牌上的技能。

ruleInterpretation.implementation: Self or another living role may be chosen only when its current Equipment count differs from the owner Hand count. The chosen Equipment count and original Hand cohort are frozen at actual role selection. Native discard restrictions are preserved; no impossible complete discard is offered.

ruleInterpretation.status: exact text with explicit timing inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Discard the complete Hand difference in one genuine native logical discard. After its native movement children finish, process each actual primary in original selected order. For each primary, sample the current Discard stock of the same category, excluding at least that exact original physical entity. Other simultaneously discarded original entities may be selected for a different primary. A stock shortage yields no fabricated card or draw. This per-primary live-stock/order treatment is an implementation inference, not a located official FAQ.

The deterministic match RNG and the candidate set/index/states are frozen by scalar facts. Hand selection uses the owner private original entities. Random retrieval is Discard to Hand with original physical identity, not a top-deck draw or same-name replacement. Native discard invoices do not count auxiliary spill as a primary.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Xianbi target changes and paid continuation
ruleInterpretation.implementation: After the actual target count is frozen, later target equipment changes do not create an endless hand-equality chase. Real native children fully resolve before later returns. Paid skill-source loss does not revoke the frozen operation. Owner death prevents new choices/gains while already paid children finish exactly once.

ruleInterpretation.status: canonical text and same-product guide; central all-draw migration pending
ruleInterpretation.implementation: The trigger applies to real draw attempts in every actual phase, including skill draws, not only the normal Draw phase. The original requested amount is frozen before physical DrawPile payment. Obtain original foreign Hand/Equipment instead; replacement obtained entities are not ordinary draw entities. Compensation is a separate genuine draw attempt.

ruleInterpretation.status: client selector plus explicit lifetime and source-classification inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: The selected other role must have enough legally obtainable HE for the frozen requested count. The other role chooses equal compensation draw or a permanent owner-target prohibition on later general-card skill targeting. The mark survives actual skill loss and regrant. Primary, secondary and acquired general-skill grants are considered; equipment-origin skill grants and card target admission are distinct. Permanent lifetime and broad grant-origin classification are implementation inferences, not a located official FAQ. Generic and custom operation target paths must all admit the same query before full activation.

One paid replacement per owner in the exact native ActualDiscardRecoveryPhaseKey token, including another player actual phases and supported inserted phases. It does not reuse the Play-only debit/reset clock. Native draw attempts without an actual phase are not offered during this integration stage; no per-draw or producer boundary is invented as an extra phase. Their intended quota is unresolved and the general remains unavailable.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Zenrun original HE payment and native children
ruleInterpretation.status: native implementation with explicit payment timing inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: The chooser privately selects exactly the frozen requested number of foreign original HE slots. The whole gain pays once in a native multi-source batch; GeneralWeapon equipment whose native destination is Outside is not a legal Hand-gain material. The paid replacement is committed before original SilverLion, WoodenOx spill, health, ownership and Dying descendants. Those real children complete before the victim chooses compensation. Paid skill loss or recipient death does not redraw or revoke the replacement. A living victim can still take the promised compensation after the recipient dies; a dead victim opens no new menu.

architecture.pendingState: Owning ProgramSkillFrame typed receipts and exact native parent returns. No global pending/use-ID sidecar.
architecture.events: New Xianbi and Zenrun rule facts are scalar. Private selected slots/materials live only on defensively frozen owning frame receipts. Replacement gains are separate from ordinary draw IDs.
architecture.allDrawMigration: Xianbi top-up and Zenrun compensation use BeginOperationProgramDraw and the exact dual-operation callback. Ordinary and extra Draw-phase attempts and native DrawTwo use the same exact NativeDrawAttempt context; each actual DrawTwo effect owns a typed CardUse receipt and returns only after its actual gain descendants. Own observer edges accept only NativeDrawAttemptRidesOn between the actual owning frame, attempt, lifecycle window and current candidate, then the existing exact native observer suffix. Central migration of other native draw callers remains pending.
